apply.note: Firm's own early-careers hub, which lists open early-career and internship postings.

process.quote: We typically post jobs in September to hire interns and co-ops for the following calendar year. The majority of our interviews take place from September-March. We will continue interviewing until our positions are filled, so we suggest applying as early as possible.

cooling_off.notes: The page carries no sentence addressing reapplication, waiting periods, or a cap on applications. Searched the fetched markup for 'reappl', 're-appl' and 'apply again': no match.

unfiled_quotes.quote: Our summer internships are 12+ weeks, and our co-ops are 4-6 months.
Our early career positions are based out of our offices (New York, Boston, Denver, Paris, or Madrid).
You may have the opportunity to join Datadog full-time after you graduate!
